properties.decision: A TemporalFact's `subject_id` is the AUTHORITY for its subject, and HAS_TEMPORAL_FACT is its derived copy: exactly one such edge, from the node `subject_id` names, kept by the store on every write. An edge drawn by hand from any other node to say "this finding also concerns that node" becomes ABOUT_ENTITY (fact → node), the edge the schema already declares for that relation. Five findings carry such a second link today, 4 besides their subject and 1 instead of it. Each moves to ABOUT_ENTITY, and the repair reports every move.
properties.name: HAS_TEMPORAL_FACT means only "this node is the finding's subject"; "the finding also concerns that node" is ABOUT_ENTITY
properties.rationale: Anthony chose this on 2026-09-28 from two options put to him after the root cause (fact:root-cause-each-writer-draws-the-second-copy-by-hand-and-three-writers-never-did-2026-09-28). The rejected option was to let HAS_TEMPORAL_FACT mean "any node that carries this finding", with the subject required among them. That would move nothing, but the edge would keep two meanings, and ABOUT_ENTITY would remain a second way to say one of them: the twin this work exists to remove, one level up. One meaning per edge also keeps the drift check a plain equality: the edge's source equals subject_id.
